purpose: Forecast incremental controlled-trial costs from one complete day of measured demand; these are not observed costs of an active replacement collector.

measurement.raw_delivery: Not yet enabled or observed; no missing storage metric is treated as zero use.

limitations: The existing viewer is instance billed. The forecast reserves an additional full measured viewer lifetime or flush time at ten times observed demand, whichever is greater; it does not attribute the existing service bill to tracking.

Native CSV sizing/file frequency and security-log amplification are forecast allowances, not measured new-source delivery. Confirm them during the trial and revise or pause if the forecast exceeds $25/month.

Source-bucket dataset transfer already occurring is excluded. Operations includes only incremental tracker operations/transfer plus Scheduler/metric-read allowances; raw/state includes their replication.
This forecast covers native logs and the currently deployable catalog reporter. Re-measure before claiming cost coverage for additional consumer runtime rollout or traffic outside these allowances.

One deployment canary is authorized initially. Source readiness stays unverified and the daily Scheduler stays paused until a source passes real delivery checks. No organization policy/sink review is a prerequisite.
This is a spending target and forecast, not a hard billing cap. Preserve historical evidence; do not remove legacy resources during this trial.
